name: Nifty
description:
Connect Nifty to Claude to analyze your reselling business across every marketplace you sell on. Claude can search and filter your inventory, pull full details on any item, check inventory health, review order history with financial detail, and break down sales and profit by marketplace, brand, and category. Useful for spotting what's selling, finding stale listings, comparing margins across platforms, and understanding your P&L without exporting spreadsheets.

Nifty unifies inventory and sales for resellers on eBay, Poshmark, Mercari, Depop, Etsy, and Whatnot.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Nifty to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Nifty to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.nifty.ai/api/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Nifty MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Nifty provides these MCP tools: get_analytics_overview, get_inventory_item, get_inventory_summary, get_labels, get_profit_and_loss_report, search_inventory, and search_orders.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Nifty?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Nifty in commerce-shopping on the Manufact MCP catalog include EbooksDepository, ecoExperten Energieausweis, PHS Pallets, Promotion Pros Catalog, and RCO-A2A.
Nifty requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Nifty is developed by Nifty AI LLC. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
